title: 第一卷 第158章 中洲秘境要开了第一卷 第157章 给玄天宗传音
slug: 失踪十年小师妹让全宗门跪下迎接
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：失踪十年，小师妹让全宗门跪下迎接第一卷第158章中洲秘境要开了（..la）混元宗如今元气大伤。
要是趁此机会得到一叶宗的地盘，混元宗能更快恢复元气。
到时候整个宗门的综合实力提上来了，就算没有拿到紫燕灵果，他们也能跻身中洲一流宗门的行列里。
而且，一叶宗在当缩头乌龟之前，全宗弟子，主动走的主动走，被遣散的被遣散。
其中有十几个被遣散的弟子，资质不错。
年纪轻轻的，全都达到分神期了。
是一叶宗之前很耀眼的天才修士。
明明已经被宗门遣散，可他们却没有加入别的宗门。
这十余年来，他们一直在中洲当游荡散修。
甚至就连他们混元宗抛出去的橄榄枝，都被他们拒绝了。
单单是拒绝就算了，他们还特厌恶混元宗，明里暗里地经常跟混元宗作对。
人往高处走，水往低处流，树倒猢狲散，良禽择木而栖才是正常修士的选择，混元宗明明比一叶宗的威望和综合实力更高，他不明白他们为何拒绝。
因此，他们这副做派让乔守玄极其不爽。
乔守玄想，要是自己把一叶宗抢夺下来，并入混元宗的领域，一定能让这几个不听话，但对一叶宗归属感极强的泼猴儿，乖乖地跪在自己山门前求收留。
不过那个时候，自己可不是随随便便什么阿猫阿狗都愿意收留的宗门了。
乔守玄嘴角微微一翘，大手一挥，下达了指令。
“纠集合体期和大乘期以上的长老与宗门修士，随我前往一叶宗。这一次，我们要赶在中洲其他宗门出动之前，先下手为强，把一叶宗这块肥肉吃下去。”
……
东洲。
玄天宗。

段千锤和几个长老端正地团团围坐在宗主大殿里。
在他们的中间，是洛还真的高级传音符。
里面的小宗主的虚幻影像正一本正经地跟他们讲自己前往中洲这一路的经过，以及接下来的指令。
听见要选取一批精锐弟子前往中洲的秘境历练，长老俱是狂喜。
之前温衡那个事儿，温衡就是拿玄天宗弟子能去中洲秘境当由头对洛还真进行发难的。
他们当时放弃维护温衡，坚定选择洛还真的时候，本以为这辈子都没有机会再让宗门弟子接触到中洲的秘境了。
可没想到命运竟然送来了如此一份慷慨大礼！
洛还真的影像结束，众长老便立刻站了起来。
“快，开始挑选人才。”
“要敢闯敢拼，有资质不怕死，优秀的弟子！”
“对了，这过路费不菲……人数没有限制的话，就是看宗门财力了，赶紧凑灵石，不够就去找那些友好宗门借！”
“太上长老，您意下如何？”
洛还真不在，大家各司其职。
但很多时候一些宗门大事，他们会找段千锤过一下意见。
段千锤捋着胡须，没有意见，“就这么办。”
长老们便高高兴兴地散了。
他们选人才的去选人才，凑灵石的去凑灵石。
而段千锤一副仙风道骨的姿态回到自己的洞府，赶紧又掏出了自己的笔墨纸砚——
“嚯哟！大事件，大事件，小真真游历到中洲的所见所闻，算是开新地图了！得记录！”
现在，他除了平时收集一些亲自经历，或者是听来的八卦外，还开始给洛还真写单独的个人传记了。

洛还真不在的日子里，他可没有闲着。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: After being missing for ten years, the junior sister asked the entire sect to kneel down to welcome the secret realm of Central Continent in Volume 1 Chapter 158 (..la) The Hunyuan Sect is now seriously weakened.
If they take this opportunity to acquire Yiye Sect's territory, Hunyuan Sect can recover faster.
By then, the overall strength of the entire sect will be improved, and even if they don't get the Purple Swallow Spirit Fruit, they will be able to rank among the first-class sects in Central Continent.
Moreover, before Yiye Sect became a coward, all the disciples of the sect left on their own initiative, and those who were dismissed were dismissed.
Among them were a dozen dismissed disciples with good qualifications.
The young ones have all reached the stage of distraction.
He was a talented monk who was very dazzling before the One Leaf Sect.
Although they had been dismissed by the sect, they did not join other sects.
For more than ten years, they have been wandering around Central Continent as monks.
Even the olive branch extended by their Hunyuan Sect was rejected by them.
Even if they just refuse, they also hate the Hunyuan Sect and often oppose the Hunyuan Sect overtly and covertly.
People walk to higher places, water flows to lower places, trees fall and hozens scatter, and good birds choose trees to roost. This is the choice of normal monks. The Hunyuan Sect clearly has higher prestige and overall strength than the Yiye Sect. He doesn't understand why they refuse.
Therefore, their behavior made Qiao Shouxuan extremely unhappy.
Qiao Shouxuan thought that if he snatched the Yiye Sect and merged it into the domain of the Hunyuan Sect, he would surely make these disobedient people, but with a strong sense of belonging to the Yiye Sect, kneel obediently in front of his mountain gate and beg to be taken in.
But at that time, I was not a sect that was willing to take in just any cat or dog.
The corners of Qiao Shouxuan's mouth curled up slightly, and with a wave of his hand, he gave the order.
"Gather the elders and monks from the sects who are in the collective stage and the Mahayana stage and above to follow me to Yiye Sect. This time, we have to take advantage of the Yiye Sect before other sects in Central Continent move out."
…
Dongzhou.
Xuantian Sect.
Duan Qianchui and several elders sat in an upright circle in the sect master's hall.
In the middle of them was Luo Huanzhen's advanced teleportation talisman.
The illusory image of the little sect master inside was telling them seriously about his journey to Central Continent and his next instructions.
When they heard that a group of elite disciples would be selected to go to the secret realm of Central Continent to experience, the elders were all ecstatic.
In the previous incident involving Wen Heng, Wen Heng used the fact that Xuantian Sect disciples could go to the secret realm of Central Continent as an excuse to attack Luo Huanzhen.
When they gave up protecting Wen Heng and firmly chose Luo Huanzhen, they thought they would never have the chance to let the sect disciples come into contact with the secret realm of Central Continent in this life.
I never expected that fate would send such a generous gift!
When Luo Huanzhen's image ended, the elders immediately stood up.
"Quickly, start selecting talents."
"Dare to venture and fight hard. If you have qualifications, you are not afraid of death. You are an outstanding disciple!"
"By the way, this toll is expensive... If there is no limit on the number of people, it just depends on the sect's financial resources. Hurry up and collect the spirit stones. If you don't have enough, go to those friendly sects to borrow them!"
"Supreme Elder, what do you think?"
Luo Huanzhen is not here, so everyone performs their duties.
But many times they would ask Duan Qianchui for advice on some major sect matters.
Duan Qianchui stroked his beard and had no objection, "That's it."
The elders then dispersed happily.
Those who choose talents choose talents, and those who gather spiritual stones gather spiritual stones.
Duan Qianchui returned to his cave with a fairy-like attitude, and quickly took out his pen, ink, paper and inkstone——
"Oh! Big event, big event. What Xiao Zhenzhen saw and heard while traveling to Central Continent is a new map! It needs to be recorded!"
Now, in addition to collecting some personal experiences or gossip he heard, he also started to write a separate personal biography for Luo Huanzhen.
During the days when Luo Huanzhen was away, he was not idle.
